title: Bolshevist Activities In Shanghai

Shanghai Municipal Police.
CENTRAL POLICE Station.
February 2 19 21
REPORT ON Bolshevist Activities in Shanghai.
Made by D. I. Givens Forwarded by Director of Criminal Intelligence
Sir,
The following is a memorandum on information regarding
Bolshevist activities in Shanghai communicated by three members
of the Union of Russian Army Men in Shanghai whom Mr. Ivanoff,
the Russian Assessor, sent to see me on February 2 :-
The offices of the "Shanghai Life", No. 12 Boone Road,
are the headquarters of all Bolshevist activities in Shanghai,
and is the centre from which such pro-Bolshevik organizations
as the Russian Famine Relief Committee, the Russian Democratic
Club, Esperanto School and Bolshevik Intelligence Bureau are
directed. Apart from these directly associated with the
"Shanghai Life", the most active Bolsheviks in Shanghai are :
Bogoluboff, 54 Rue Baron Gros,
Michael Popoff, Tsongchow Road,
Semechoff, 17 Yangtsepoo Road,
Peroff, No. 1 Ferry Road,
Angarsky, address unknown
Yegalevitch, " "
It is alleged that Messrs Semechoff and Peroff, both
of whom speak English, intermingle with British and American
sailors and endeavour to propagate Bolshevist ideas among them.
Angarsky and Yegalevich are said to be working in the Bolshevist
Intelligence Bureau and were formerly employed on similar
work in Vladivostock.
All the Bolsheviks named above are Russian subjects
with the exception of Peroff. The latter is an American Jew
of Russian origin.

中央捕房。
1921年2月2日
关于上海布尔什维克活动的报告。
由 D. I. Givens 编制，经刑事情报处处长转呈

先生，
兹就俄国参事伊万诺夫先生（Mr. Ivanoff）于2月2日派来见我的三名“上海俄国军人联合会”成员所通报的关于上海布尔什维克活动的情报，备忘录如下：

北四川路12号《上海生活》报社办公室是上海所有布尔什维克活动的总部，也是指挥俄罗斯饥荒救济委员会、俄罗斯民主俱乐部、世界语学校和布尔什维克情报局等亲布尔什维克组织的中心。除这些与《上海生活》直接相关的组织外，上海最活跃的布尔什维克分子有：
博戈柳博夫（Bogoluboff），格罗男爵路54号，
迈克尔·波波夫（Michael Popoff），宗周路，
谢梅乔夫（Semechoff），杨树浦路17号，
佩罗夫（Peroff），斐伦路1号，
安加尔斯基（Angarsky），地址不详
叶加列维奇（Yegalevitch），同上

据称，谢梅乔夫和佩罗夫两人均讲英语，混迹于英美水手之中，并试图在他们中间传播布尔什维克思想。据说安加尔斯基和叶加列维奇在布尔什维克情报局工作，此前曾在符拉迪沃斯托克从事类似工作。
上述所有布尔什维克分子均为俄国臣民，佩罗夫除外。后者是一名俄裔美国犹太人。

Tsingtao.

Sir,
    In accordance with your request, I have the
honour to forward herewith a list of the few
Russian Bolshevicks now in Shanghai who may be
considered dangerous.
    In future, whenever any dangerous Bolshevick is
known to leave Shanghai for Tsingtao, I will inform
you by cable.

                I have the honour to be,
                        Sir,
